objective: Close the final ambiguity between verified predicate-local activation and the irreversible one-use production claim by making claim identity a deterministic function of the exact frozen execution tuple.

breakthrough.problem: A one-use claim keyed by an underspecified execution lease can be replayed if mutable nonce, timestamp, run label, or other incidental fields are allowed to change the lease digest.
breakthrough.solution: Freeze a nonce-free canonical lease payload. Exactly one qualified and activated execution tuple maps to exactly one SHA-256 digest and exactly one refs/heads/unknown-domain-direct-claims/<digest> claim ref.
breakthrough.effect: Changing any load-bearing execution blob changes identity; changing incidental run metadata is impossible because such metadata is excluded from the schema.
breakthrough.transitive_dependency_repair: Generator V2 imports Generator V1; Generator V1 was not content-addressed by the earlier production precommit. The lease now binds Generator V1 so the executed generator closure cannot drift under an unchanged V2 blob.
